build_GFLHead: build a GFLHead instance for dense object detection with configurable stacked convolutions and reg_max
forward_GFLHead: run forward pass on multi-scale feature tensors to get classification scores and bbox distribution logits
loss_by_feat_GFLHead: calculate classification, bbox regression, and distribution focal losses for training the GFL head
predict_GFLHead: transform feature predictions into detected bounding boxes with scores and labels using NMS post-processing
get_targets_GFLHead: compute anchor targets including labels, bbox targets, and sampling results for positive and negative anchors
